visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static split-screen comparison showing a dramatic physical transformation. On the left, a younger man with short black hair and glasses wears a black tank top, appearing lean and unmuscular against a neutral indoor wall. On the right, the same man appears significantly more muscular, bearded, and tanned, posing in a black tank top against a dark, minimalist background to highlight his shoulder and arm definition. (2) The scene transitions to a well-lit gym interior where the man, now wearing a black cap and tank top, is performing a barbell bench press on a flat bench. He lowers the weighted bar to his chest and presses it upward with controlled movements. In the background, other fitness equipment, weight racks, and gym signage like 'STEPX' are visible under bright, cool-toned overhead lighting. (3) The man moves to a Smith machine to perform an incline bench press. He is seated on an inclined bench, gripping the bar and executing repetitions that emphasize the upper chest. The environment features industrial-style ceilings and rows of treadmills in the distant background. (4) The camera provides a close-up, top-down perspective of the man using a chest fly machine. His facial expression shows focused exertion as he pulls the machine handles together, making his chest muscles contract visibly. Yellow text overlays appear intermittently at the top and bottom of the frame. (5) Standing cable flys are performed as the man stands between two pulley towers, pulling the handles forward in a wide arc. The gym's lighting creates high contrast on his physique, accentuating muscle separation. (6) The man finishes his workout, standing upright with hands on his hips and a relaxed smile, exhaling while facing the camera. He is surrounded by gym machinery and storage racks, concluding the visual sequence.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 大家好這是Peeta哥哥. (2) [Subtitle]: 今天要來分享我的練胸課表. (3) [Subtitle]: 這四個動作都是我覺得S級的練胸動作. (4) [Subtitle]: 首先是臥推三組一組6-8下. (5) [Subtitle]: 槓鈴臥推跟啞鈴臥推都很棒也各有優缺點. (6) [Subtitle]: 我會挑槓鈴是因為強度比較容易上去. (7) [Subtitle]: 當第一個動作也可以比較明確感受到自己的強度有沒有穩定在進步. (8) [Subtitle]: 第二個動作是上胸推類型的動作三組8-10下. (9) [Subtitle]: 上胸飽滿對於身材是非常加分的. (10) [Subtitle]: 目標就是讓我們的乳溝長到脖子的高度. (11) [Subtitle]: 推薦大家可以用啞鈴史密斯或者器械上胸推都是很棒的動作. (12) [Subtitle]: 那我現在用的這一台是Evolgear的史密斯上胸推. (13) [Subtitle]: 它結合了啞鈴跟史密斯的優點行程夠長過程穩定感受度極佳真的非常的讚. (14) [Subtitle]: 第三個動作是夾胸三組遞減組10-12下. (15) [Subtitle]: 我們這邊用的是Evolgear的夾胸器材. (16) [Subtitle]: 那如果沒有的話你也是可以用滑輪取代. (17) [Subtitle]: 我們盡量專注在離心的階段讓胸肌拉到最長的感覺. (18) [Subtitle]: 那做完12下之後我們遞減30%的重量接著再做一組遞減組才算完成一組. (19) [Subtitle]: 最後一個動作是滑輪上夾胸三組一組10-12下. (20) [Subtitle]: 這個動作就是榨乾我們上胸最後的精力所以盡量可以把它做到力竭. (21) [Subtitle]: 最後非常推薦大家一定要來用Evolgear的器材操練看看非常的舒服.

The acoustic environment is clean, with very subtle indoor room resonance. (2) As the narrator describes the bench press, a sharp metallic click of the barbell leaving the rack is audible. The speaker's vocal quality shows slight strain, consistent with physical exertion, while maintaining clear articulation and a moderate speech rate. (3) The rhythmic clanking of weight plates occurs repeatedly during the workout descriptions. The BGM remains constant in tempo and volume, serving as an upbeat backdrop. The narrator's pitch variability increases slightly when emphasizing 'S-grade' movements. (4) A mechanical latching sound from the Smith machine triggers a transition in the narration. The speaker's arousal level is high, conveying enthusiasm for the training routine. The ambient noise floor remains low, ensuring the primary vocal signal is dominant. (5) The whirring sound of cable pulleys is heard as the narrator explains the final isolation exercises. The voice maintains a high dominance level, sounding confident and instructional. The BGM beat remains prominent until the final sign-off.
